# Voice

## Signature lines

> Rates moved again this week. Here's what that means if you're buying in South Austin.
> I'd rather you ask me the "dumb" question now than at the closing table.
> Pre-approval isn't a promise. It's a plan.

## Words we use

- "folks", "South Austin", "plan", "options"

## Words we never use

- "dream home", "act now", "lowest rates"
